summary: Two climbers called for help after dark when unable to find the East Slabs descent after completing Anthill Direct (5 pitches, 5.9-) on Redgarden Wall; no headlamps, rope stuck on rappel. RMRG climbed to them at night in snowy conditions and guided them down; rescue took approximately eight hours; no injuries.
location: Redgarden Wall, Eldorado Canyon State Park
notes: ANAM 2021 (climb year 2020); sunset 7:15pm; guided down East Slabs descent
